summary: Shows subset and superset tests (renamed from issubset/issuperset in 2.5) to check list inclusion.
questions: How do I check if one list contains all items of another?
What happened to issubset in Ansible?

answer_card.title: subset and superset tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
when: a is superset(b)   # a includes b
when: b is subset(a)     # b included in a
```

(`issubset` / `issuperset` were renamed in 2.5.)
